title: Isolated generated HTML previews and authenticated review bridge
whatBuilt: HTML CONTENT SANDBOX: generated HTML scanned and bounded before any preview is served; script tags, event handlers, external URLs, iframe/embed/object/form/input, CSS url()/expression/@import, <meta http-equiv>, and dangerous attributes all REFUSED (never stripped — dangerous content is refused outright)

ORIGIN + MESSAGE CONTROLS: the review bridge only accepts postMessage events from the AUTHORIZED preview origin; message types validated (ready/content-update/error/resize); content-update messages re-scanned through the sandbox; oversized payloads refused
AUTHENTICATED REVIEW BRIDGE: only the artifact owner (or authorized reviewer/custodian) can open sessions; the model CANNOT open sessions; sessions are time-bounded; cross-owner requests denied
ACCESSIBLE ERRORS: every refusal carries a machine-readable error code AND a meaningful text alternative
Content Security Policy returned with each session (default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:)

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 291/291 pass (274 previous + 17 previewsandbox)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The sandbox is the CONTRACT plane; actual hosted preview rendering (real browser, real origin) and KAN-132's code-execution runtime remain gated. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
